body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production Unity game sprite extraction. Edit the attached blue cloud prize machine. Return the exact same full machine BODY at its original position, original proportions, same 1156x1360 canvas and completely transparent background. Remove ONLY the green spherical lever knob and the slanted silver shaft on the RIGHT SIDE, leaving the rounded pale blue fixed pivot/housing intact and cleanly completing the small housing surface behind the shaft. Do not remove the top green dome. Preserve the machine body, blue colors, clouds, glass highlights, empty dark blue recess, legs, proportions and all edges as exactly as possible. No new decorations. True RGBA transparency, no opaque black or checkerboard background. Smooth anti-aliased edges. This is the body layer for an articulated lever, so NO right green knob or silver stem may remain.
parts: Use case: background-extraction. Unity articulated game sprite atlas on TRUE transparent RGBA background. Extract ONLY the RIGHT SIDE green spherical lever knob and its slanted shiny silver metal shaft from the input machine. Return exactly TWO separate disconnected pieces, with large transparent padding: on the LEFT HALF of a wide canvas, the original glossy green spherical knob alone, round with its original white highlight, no stem. On the RIGHT HALF of the canvas, the original silver metal shaft alone, tilted upper end to the right, lower end to the left (about 11 degrees), length about 1.25x the knob diameter, width about 0.30x knob diameter; extend its top slightly so it can slide under the knob. No housing, no machine body, no top dome, no backdrop, no labels, no checkerboard pattern. Keep the same rendered materials, proportions, colors and smooth crisp antialiased cutout edges as the reference. These will be assembled as moving native UI Image objects. Do not put both pieces touching or on a common base.
